items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: Well, Buddy Bolin, I really didn't know him.

ctx.x: Of course... When I talked to you about, oh, it's been, I guess, 10 years ago, once at the famous door, I think you told me you remembered when you were a boy hearing music up in the neighborhood, some of the colored... Was it Buddy Bolin or somebody near there?
Well, there were a lot of colored people around there. Well, Buddy Bolin, I really didn't know him. He, I think he died before my time, but my older brothers knew him.
